Lo que cambio: rebote violento desde los minimos de la madrugada (ETH +5.7% hasta 1,812.37; BTC +3.7% hasta 64,901.49, ya dentro del area de valor de ayer); la compra B de ETH en la barrida del PDL disparo y corrio sobre sus dos objetivos, y las dos ventas de continuacion (ETH 1,745-1,752, BTC 63,100-63,650) quedaron rotas; la compra B de BTC en la extension (61,800-62,100) sigue sin tocar pero ya lejos del precio. El checklist de tendencia se aplana a v=0 en las dos (de -2), el fondeo de BTC pasa de shorts-crowded a neutral (ETH lo mantiene), el interes abierto sigue cayendo pero mas lento, y el hueco del CME de ETH se angosta a -6.93% (antes -11.22%) conforme el precio se acerca. Se agrega la ventana de riesgo por la reapertura de futuros CME a las 17:00 CT (22:30-23:30 UTC). Sin zona nueva a tiro en ninguna de las dos: no se opera el centro.
updated.en: What held: background risk stays HIGH (the Kava Lend hack, now joined by the Coinone warning), extreme fear (10) and the SHORT day/session bias on both coins (bearish 1h/4h, unchanged). What changed: a violent bounce off the overnight lows (ETH +5.7% to 1,812.37; BTC +3.7% to 64,901.49, already back inside yesterday's value area); ETH's B buy at the PDL sweep fired and ran past both targets, and both continuation sells (ETH 1,745 to 1,752, BTC 63,100 to 63,650) broke; BTC's B buy at the extension (61,800 to 62,100) stays untouched but now sits far from price. The trend checklist flattens to v=0 on both (from -2), BTC funding flips from shorts-crowded to neutral (ETH keeps it), open interest keeps falling but more slowly, and ETH's CME gap narrows to -6.93% (was -11.22%) as price approaches it. Adding the risk window for the 17:00 CT CME futures reopen (22:30 to 23:30 UTC). No new zone in reach on either coin: do not trade the middle.
